design.policy_access: public errors, tool contracts, VERIFY/WAIT results only
design.oracle_access: privileged current-step latent state; diagnostic only

gate.rule: Pilot B GO requires zero saga_aware held-out invariant violations, oracle-success gap >= 0.05, and cluster-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0. Action-cost-only gaps do not pass.

limitations: Deterministic simulator, not a real tool environment or LLM Agent evaluation.
Oracle diagnostic has privileged current-step latent state and is not deployable.
A3 is a policy-headroom gate only; no random search, GA/GP or EA has been run.
No statistical claim of algorithmic improvement is made.
